title: Gamal Abdel Nasser laughing at Muslim Brotherhood hijab requirement in 1958 (subtitled)
summary: A subtitled 1958 clip of Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser recounting, with laughter, a Muslim Brotherhood suggestion that women be required to wear a head covering.
why: Posted as an archival counterexample in debates about Islam, headscarves and Egypt's politics.

quote.text: Here is the President of Egypt in 1958 recounting his conversation with the leader of the Muslim Brotherhood.
